_note: The remaining 68 of the 88 genuinely-new (not in training pool, not in the held-out eval set) viral NLS motif accessions from the same live UniProt pull documented in viral_nls_candidates_2026-08-05.json. Sequences NOT yet fetched for these -- accession/organism/motif position/evidence only, for later use if the curated 20 aren't enough. Heavily weighted toward large flavivirus polyprotein strain duplicates (Yellow Fever virus x9, Zika x3, JEV x2, plus Banzi/Edge Hill/Wesselsbron/Dengue), which mostly share one ~19-25aa bipartite motif near residue 83-101 of a 3000+ residue polyprotein -- not the short/atypical motif class this round of candidate-gathering was targeting, but real and usable if more raw volume/diversity is wanted later. Also includes redundant HCV isolate duplicates (all sharing the same 4 motifs at 5-13/38-43/58-64/66-71) and additional polyomavirus paralogs (BK/JC/Murine/Bovine/Simian-12/Budgerigar strains, ~7-10aa T-antigen-type motifs).
